results.title: About Us | Liber Holdings
results.summary:
Liber Holdings is a family-owned industrial MRO distributor based in Texas with roots dating to 1946. Key points relevant to your query:
- Founded/Origin: The lineage begins with RBC Industrial (formerly Roger Brown Co), a Texas-based distributor established in 1946 in El Paso.
- Family leadership: The business has stayed within a family/related leadership lineage, with Roger Brown Sr. (Naval Engineer) founding the original company, followed by Roger Brown Jr. and later Dale Betz (owner since 2016), a West Point graduate and Army Special Forces veteran.
- Current structure: Liber Holdings is the holding company that acquired the Texas-origin Roger Brown Co (RBC Industrial) in 2016, continuing the family-oriented MRO and industrial distribution legacy.
- Related entities: Includes RBC Industrial (rebranded from Roger Brown Co), Liber Industrial (focused on industrial MRO supply and specialty chemicals; originally formed 2018 but the public-facing line has since evolved), Tooling Components (mold/die/polishing supplies), and Globe Electric Supply Co Inc (invested to grow government infrastructure projects).

If you’re specifically seeking a family-owned MRO distributor in Texas with a 1970s founding reference, RBC Industrial (as the Texas-origin entity of Liber Holdings) aligns closely with that history, tracing back to 1946 and continuing under family/management-led ownership through the Liber Holdings umbrella.

results.title: About Us - Byler Rivet Supply

Summary:
Byler Rivet Supply is a family-owned industrial MRO distributor based in Texas, founded in the 1970s. The company originated in 1974 when Johnny and Jimmie Byler launched R & A Supply, later forming Byler Rivet Supply through a 1999 merger of two family businesses. The Byler family expanded leadership across generations (Kate Forsythe and John Byler joining in the late 1990s/early 2000s) and now operates from a 40,000-square-foot facility. They position themselves as problem solvers for rivets, fasteners, tooling, and custom packaging, offering guidance, expertise, and solutions for customers’ fastening needs.
